data.title: Exploring Halves, Thirds, and Fourths

challenges.instruction: What fraction of the circle is shaded?
challenges.hint: Count the equal parts, then count the shaded parts.
challenges.narration: What fraction of the circle is shaded?

challenges.hint: Look at the equal parts and the amount you need to shade.

challenges.instruction: Touch the picture showing one fourth.
challenges.hint: Look at the equal parts and the shaded parts.
challenges.narration: Touch the picture showing one fourth.

challenges.instruction: Compare 1/2 and 1/4. Which fraction is larger, or are they equal?
challenges.hint: Compare the shaded amounts in the two equal-sized circles.
challenges.narration: Compare 1/2 and 1/4. Which fraction is larger, or are they equal?

challenges.instruction: Build a fraction equivalent to 1/2 using 4 equal slices.
challenges.hint: Look at the equal parts and the amount you need to shade.
challenges.narration: Build a fraction equivalent to 1/2 using 4 equal slices.

data.description: Practice identifying, building, comparing, and finding equivalent fractions for halves, thirds, and fourths.

actionContract.label: Touch the fraction
actionContract.instruction: Touch the picture showing one fourth.
actionContract.checkingInstruction: Look at the picture you touched and listen.
